'''Tik'A'Moris''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived during the last days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Personality and traits==
Tik'A'Moris loved the thrill of discovery and learning new facts. He was never satisfied with his current level of knowledge when the whole [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] awaited to provide more. He was always enthusiastic about every new discovery he made and this drove him to keep searching for new and greater challenges, but he could also obsess over a single discovery to the exclusion of all else.<ref name="FD BETA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tik'A'Moris appears as an introductory character for [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[Star Wars: Force and Destiny|''Force and Destiny'']] [[roleplaying game]] [[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Beta|Beta]].<ref name="FD BETA" />
